title: Whimsical Egg Machine Dream
description: A large cracked egg-shaped mechanical creature with an orange beak, blue eyes, and steampunk gears stands in a swirling vortex of colorful smoke and leaves. An orange cat leaps energetically beside it while tiny human figures, a celestial orb, and floating characters emerge from a glowing swirl above.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a giant cracked egg-shaped mechanical being with steampunk gears, an orange bird beak, and large expressive blue eyes. The creature has tiny human figures painted on its shell and stands within a dynamic swirling vortex of red, pink, green and yellow smoke. A bright orange cat is leaping beside it. Above, glowing ethereal figures and a celestial orb float in a magical spiral against a dark cloudy background.
